def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return [0] * n

    values = sorted(set(a))
    rank = {value: i + 1 for i, value in enumerate(values)}
    ranks = [rank[value] for value in a]
    m = len(values)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)
    result = [0] * n

    for i, r in enumerate(ranks):
        if i > k:
            j = ranks[i - k - 1]
            while j <= m:
                bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & -j

        not_taller = 0
        j = r
        while j > 0:
            not_taller += bit[j]
            j -= j & -j

        result[i] = min(i, k) - not_taller

        j = r
        while j <= m:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

    return result
